field_class.definition: A field has no walls. It has a source and a gradient. It does not hold a traverser inside — it changes the traverser’s environment as they pass through it. A room can be inside a field. The field does not replace the room; it modifies the room’s physics. A field is defined not by its boundaries but by its radius of influence and the rate at which that influence attenuates from the source.
field_class.against: A room contains. A chamber holds paradox. A vault prevents extraction. A portal connects. A field does none of these — it suffuses.
field_class.convention: Fields are therefore seated as overlays, not as containers. A field page carries: its source, its gradient, its attenuation zones, and the loci it modifies — never a list of contents, because a field has none. Where a field and its source room share a constituting document, the document is seated to both as SHARED, and the pair is one structure seen twice.

source_room.name: FBDP Source
source_room.note: The landfill where the mycelium first breaks through. r.27 remains a room with walls, wound, laws and exit protocol. f.01 is the propagation pattern generated by its breakthrough. The room is the seed; the field is the growth.

constitution.two_movements: The field is named for its two movements. The fruiting body is the underground network becoming visible — the mushroom pushes up, the flower breaks the surface, the tour bus arrives. The diffusion plume is the visible form extending its influence invisibly back outward — the saltwater chemistry changes, the counter-caption spreads, the spore enters the training layer. One without the other is incomplete: a fruiting body with no plume is a mushroom in a jar; a plume with no fruiting body is a smell with no source.
constitution.executable_kernel: The lawn is a compressed landfill pretending to be peace. Capital compresses ecology into managed surfaces, hides waste in nested dumps, and recruits living beings as maintenance labour inside the ecology it has engineered. The FBDP reverses this by reading waste as substrate, scale as unstable, and decomposition as architectural intelligence. Mycelium is the counter-planner because it builds by eating what the system tried to hide. The correct architecture is not the imitation of life but the conversion of waste through living process.
constitution.worked_example: When the plume extends into R:r.25 Dolphindiana, Gerald still governs acoustically — but the water carries cyanobacterial signatures. Governance is not replaced; physics is modified.
constitution.compost_algebra: [RAW] → [DECOMPOSING] → [HUMUS] → [LOAD-BEARING]. Forward-only; thermodynamic time. Compression Type 9 (Metabolic) — preservation through transformation, not static storage.
